question: Who succeeded in securing trading concessions for the East India Company from Mughal Emperor Jahangir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thomas Roe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Thomas Roe was an English diplomat sent by James I to the court of Mughal Emperor Jahangir in 1615.
 
• He successfully negotiated trading rights in 1617, allowing the East India Company to establish a factory in Surat.
